candidate.blueprint_locator: Safe and Effective Care Environment — Safety and Infection Prevention and Control: use measures that reduce infection-related risk and support safe evidence-based care; related activities include infection prevention and quality/safety practices.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — hospital antibiotic stewardship
candidate.educational_objective: Describe hospital antibiotic stewardship as a patient-safety and resistance-prevention system that measures antibiotic use, implements evidence-based prescribing interventions, and tracks outcomes rather than simply maximizing or minimizing antibiotic exposure.

options.A: Measure antibiotic use and resistance, implement interventions such as audit-and-feedback or preauthorization, and improve appropriate antibiotic use to protect patients and combat antimicrobial resistance.
options.B: Increase broad-spectrum antibiotic prescribing for all admitted clients so treatment begins before an indication is established.
options.C: Eliminate antibiotic therapy whenever possible, including for infections in which antibiotics provide a clear clinical benefit.
options.D: Limit stewardship activities to outpatient settings because inpatient antibiotic prescribing is outside the CDC Core Elements.

candidate.rationale: A is correct. CDC defines antibiotic stewardship as the effort to measure and improve how antibiotics are prescribed and used. Its hospital Core Elements include action strategies such as prospective audit and feedback or preauthorization, tracking of antibiotic prescribing and outcomes including resistance patterns and C. difficile infection, reporting, and education. The goal is appropriate antibiotic use that improves patient care and combats antimicrobial resistance—not indiscriminate expansion or elimination of antibiotic therapy. D is incorrect because CDC has a specific hospital stewardship framework applicable to hospitals of all sizes.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Hospital antibiotic stewardship programs measure and improve antibiotic use through structured interventions, tracking, reporting and education to improve patient care, reduce avoidable antibiotic harms, and combat antimicrobial resistance.
candidate.source_document_title: Core Elements of Hospital Antibiotic Stewardship Programs; Core Elements of Antibiotic Stewardship

Core Elements overview: stewardship is the effort to measure and improve antibiotic prescribing and use to advance patient safety and outcomes.
